identification: Antique English high-back Windsor armchair, Yorkshire/Lincolnshire style: hooped back with pierced vase-shaped splat, turned arm supports, saddle elm seat, turned legs, crinoline (crescent) stretcher. Dark old finish; catalogue says oak and elm c1860. Timber looks like ash/elm with a dark patina, not obviously yew. Estimate 200-300, current bid $100.
